_note: The donee-report bar: a donation to a charitable fund or institution is allowed only on the information the donee furnishes. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.133(6) (p.169), "Any claim of deduction … in case of a donation made to an institution or fund referred in sub-section (1)(b)(ii), shall be allowed–– (a) only on the basis of the information relating to such donation furnished by such institution or fund …" (plans/W-078f.md:30) — it reaches (1)(b)(ii) only (D-142 erratum). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80G(5D) Explanation 2A, inserted by the Finance Act, 2020 s.33 w.e.f. 1-6-2020: "claim of the assessee for a deduction in respect of any donation made to an institution or fund to which the provisions of sub-section (5) applies … shall be allowed on the basis of information relating to said donation furnished by the institution or fund to the prescribed income-tax authority … subject to verification in accordance with the risk management strategy" — reaching the s.80G(2)(a)(iv) institutions (sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md M6). Both are DonationClause.CHARITABLE_INSTITUTION. A conditions-only row: it reaches a donation by donation.clause and donation.reported.by.donee, and a donation it reaches is a nil line on its share row naming this row (W-156a, D-344). Old regime only, as DED-DONATION-HALF.

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Finance Act, 2020 (12 of 2020), s.33 — inserts Explanation 2A in s.80G(5D) of the Income-tax Act, 1961, w.e.f. 1-6-2020

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-27032020-218938, Finance Act, 2020 s.33, pp.27–29: s.80G(5D) Explanation 2A (sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md M6); new regime: s.115BAC(2)(i) as DED-DONATION-HALF's TY 2025-26 version
